stone.title: GoStoneSounds.ogg
stone.author: billhails2
stone.downloadKind: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the login-required original OGG
stone.recording: Author describes five real Yunzi stone placements, recorded with a Marantz Professional Umpire microphone. Placements 1-3 use a wooden tabletop board with legs; 4-5 use a thin shin-kaya board.
stone.selection: Fifth placement, shin-kaya board; stronger natural low/mid resonance

comparison.method: PCM analysis, not human listening. Equal peak levels; lower spectral energy centroid and increased low/mid energy support the heavier candidate selection.

behavior: Real recorded Go-stone placement uses the fifth Yunzi/shin-kaya recording, with unchanged pitch and a stronger natural low/mid body.
Intro, opponent win and opponent loss dialogue reveal text elements one at a time, at a minimum 0.04-second interval.
Each non-whitespace element plays the saved UI click at scale 0.18; sound OFF leaves the animation active and silent.
Transparent unrevealed text preserves wrapping and best-fit size. Existing Excel Korean/English dialogue remains unchanged.
Pause/confirmation/settings screens, focus loss, app background and ad pending states suspend letters and clicks.
Same-line refresh preserves progress; language, stage and result changes reset the line; lobby and disable cancel old typing.
BGM continues through lobby/match transitions and pause/retry/leave confirmations; app focus/background and ad suspension remain unchanged.

tests.initialFailures: Two existing tests waited for animated dialogue without simulating batch-editor focus. One capture test had a transient NullReferenceException; its source was unchanged and it passed the rerun.
tests.repair: SpeechComplete test helper now simulates an active/focused game before awaiting full text. Runtime focus behavior was not changed.

visuals.result: Partial text is visible with hidden remainder; complete English dialogue fits its existing bubble. Both language progress/completion cases passed.

preservation: Original recording and previous stone clips preserved. Baseline art, layout prefabs except root clip reference, GameData JSON, BGM and button clip bytes unchanged.
reproducibility: Heavy WAV regenerated twice with identical SHA-256.
limits: No human listening or physical-speaker measurement.
No new WebGL/Android build, browser/device validation, commit or push.
